Galaxy AI Call Assistant

Samsung’s Galaxy AI Call Assistant has two functions: the text call, to answer without speaking, and simultaneous translation, to talk in another language. The video shows what it's for, how to configure and when to activate.

Published in 27 October 2025 · 5 min 7 s

  • AI tools

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

In this article

  1. The Problem
  2. What is Call Assistant
  3. Text Call
  4. Simultaneous translation
  5. To configure
  6. When to activate each function
  7. Frequently Asked Questions

The Problem

Sometimes an important call comes to a noisy place or in the middle of a meeting, and you can't talk. 00:21. Another barrier is to solve something by phone with someone who speaks another language, for example to book a hotel or close a business 00:42.

What is Call Assistant

Call Assistant comes with Galaxy AI. It works as a filter for those who call, as a conversation transcriptor and as a real-time interpreter 01:03. It already comes in the phone app, without installing anything 01:03.

Text Call

In the text call, the AI answers for you, transcribes what the other person says and reads aloud what you type on the screen 01:25. In addition to practice, it is an accessibility tool for people with speech or hearing difficulties 01:47.

To use, tap "Called by text" on the connection screen instead of sliding to meet 01:47. An AI voice warns another person that the call will be by text, and your screen becomes a chat 02:08.

Simultaneous translation

The simultaneous translation (Live Translate) translates what you say and what the other person says in real time 02:29. It works as much when you call as when you get the call. 02:49.

To configure

  • In the phone app, tap the three menu points, then Settings and Call Wizard 03:11.
  • There you turn on the text call, choose the language and voice of the AI and create quick answers such as "I'm in a meeting, call in 5 minutes" 03:33.
  • In simultaneous translation, activate the function, set your main language and select the other languages you want to use 03:33.

When to activate each function

Text call is activated before answering, on the call screen 04:15. Simultaneous translation is the opposite: you normally answer and, with the conversation underway, tap the Call Wizard button 04:15.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I take a call without talking?

Yeah. Tap "Called by text" before answering: AI transcribes what a person says and reads what you type 02:08.

Do I need to install an app?

Nope. Call Wizard is already on the phone app 01:03.

About the video

**Galaxy AI Answer Without Speaking and Break Language Barriers in Real Time!**

Do you ever imagine taking a crucial call in a noisy environment or in the middle of a quiet meeting? What if you could talk to anyone from another country like you had a private interpreter in your pocket?

The Samsung Galaxy AI Call Assistant is turning this into reality! He's the "Swiss AI knife" for their connections, acting as filter, transcriptor and simultaneous interpreter ([[01:06](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=66)]).

* * In this video, you will discover how to master two revolutionary functions:**

1. ** Called by Text: Discreet and Accessible (Call Assist)**
* ** Silent Communication:** Learn to answer the phone without making a sound! The AI answers for you, transcribes what the other says, and reads aloud the answers you type on the screen ([[01:33](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=93)], [[01:47](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=107)]).
* **For Who is:** Perfect for noisy environments, meetings or as a fantastic accessibility tool for people with speech or hearing difficulties ([01:53](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=113)]).
==References== The process is simple. On the call screen, tap **"Called by Texto"** before answering. His screen turns into a chat, and the AI makes the bridge with the other person ([[02:06](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=126)]).

2. **Simultaneal Translation (Live Translate): Breaking Barriers in Real Time**
==References== Understand how the function **Live Translate** (Simultaneous Translation) works in real time, translating what you say and what the other person says, flowing in both directions ([02:24](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=144)], [[02:39](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=159)], [[02:56](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=176)]).
* ** Absurd Power:** Essential to schedule hotels, close international businesses or connect with other cultures in an unprecedented way ([2:45](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=165)], [[02:49](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=169)]).
==References== Unlike the Text Call, you first answer the call normally** and, with the conversation underway, press the Call Wizard button to start the translation ([04:12](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=252)]).

Learn to configure your AI language and voice in **Configurations - Call Assistant** and get ready to have more control and connectivity in your conversations ([03:17](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ruZVjMpaEZo&t=197)]).

This is not just an update, it is a real change in the way we communicate, with AI acting as our private filter and interpreter.
